title: An Informational and Supportive Care Intervention for Patients With Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
official: PATHWAYS: An Informational and Supportive Care Intervention for Patients With Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of conducting a randomized trial of a brief psychoeducational intervention versus enhanced usual care for patients with locally advanced rectal cancer who are initiating neoadjuvant multimodality treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age≥18 years
2. Within 8 weeks after documented decision to pursue multi-modality therapy for newly diagnosed LARC (i.e., stage II or III disease)
3. Able to complete study procedures English or with the assistance of an interpreter

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Comorbid health condition that would interfere with study participation, as identified by cancer care team
2. Has undergone treatment for a prior colorectal cancer
